description: Information about the condition of a component.

error.description: error is the condition error code for a component. For example, a health check error code.

message.description: message about the condition for a component. For example, information about a health check.

status.description: status of the condition for a component. Valid values for "Healthy": "True", "False", or "Unknown".

type.description: type of condition for a component. Valid value: "Healthy"
